infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TurFit uses your location to discover nearby turfs, arenas, and sports lobbies.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TurFit uses your location to display distance and provide turn-by-turn navigation to booked turfs.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TurFit needs camera access to capture turf pictures and profile avatars.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TurFit requires photo library access to upload turf photos, arena banners, and user profile pictures.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Show nearby turfs and calculate travel distance to sports grounds.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow TurFit to select photos for turfs and avatar.
